top_signals.title: Stocks Fall on Nvidia Rout as Anthropic in Focus: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Wall Street saw renewed volatility as Nvidia Corp.’s post-earnings rally fizzled out, a sign that investors are looking for more evidence of the durability of the artificial-intelligence trade.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Credit Selloff Lures Bargain Hunters to ‘Stock Picker’s Market’
top_signals.summary: MFS Investment Management’s Pilar Gomez-Bravo and J.P. Morgan Asset Management’s Iain Stealey see opportunities in beaten-up credit after the recent selloff, particularly in lower-rated and subordinated debt. Both stressed the need for selectivity, with Gomez-Bravo calling it a “stock picker’s market” and Stealey favoring subordinated debt from strong investment-grade companies over traditional high yield, as heavy supply and higher rates make a return to relentless spread tightening unlikely. (Source: Bloomberg)
